facts.text: Sisters, sisters, never were there such.
facts.why: The line paraphrases the lyric of the Haynes Sisters' song 'Sisters', which the film features; no song lyrics may go on a menu. The Haynes Sisters are a sister act in the film.
facts.fix: The Haynes Sisters, one act, one tray.

vibe.verdict: Cosy inn with the General and the Haynes Sisters, but the food is a generic Christmas menu and the film's best bits are missing.
missing: Bob and Phil lip-syncing 'Sisters' in half-drag with blue feather boas
The soldiers surprise the General at the Christmas Eve show
Emma Allen overhearing the phone call
The mock inspection ('You're a disgrace to the outfit!')
The sisters and the club car on the train
ideas: Swap 'Aged Vermont cheddar with apple butter' note for the blue feather boas bit
Swap 'General Waverly's maple glazed ham' note for the mock inspection line
Swap 'Snowy coconut cake' note for 'The tenth anniversary cake'
Rename 'Eggnog by the fire' to 'Snow at last eggnog' for the finale
